thread:
alana: Quick sync — we need a short validation sprint to confirm the postmortem fixes actually stop the slow KV residency growth that led to OOMs. Proposed window: 7 days. Who takes what?

mike: I can own the canary rollout for soft/hard limits. Will prepare a config diff and a rollback snippet. Target: PR by EOD.

devon: I'll run lightweight profiling on 4 staging hosts and add a small tool to flag keys with >48h touch lifetime. ETA: 48h.

oncall-bot: recent signals: 3 OOMs in last 21 days on shard pool; frag-index trending up 0.03/day.

samir: I'll tweak GC and slab compaction freq in staging canary. Risk = medium (CPU spike). Will document smoke tests.

mike: Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% over 48h with auto-abort if p99 up >12% or OOM_count >0. Adding feature flag and sparks.

alana: Good. Deliverables: mike=canary PR + rollback, devon=profiles + artifact upload, samir=GC adjustments + smoke tests. Checkpoint: daily quick updates here for 3 days then sync.

devon: noted, uploading first snapshots in ~6 hours.
